page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of the ecs.d1.8xlarge is its massive bundled local storage capacity, offering 94,489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the massive capacity of its local HDD storage, this instance is designed for storage-intensive workloads that require high capacity over high random IOPS. It is suitable for large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, big data analytics, and cold data storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance for processing the stored data.
